name: Rising Stars Therapeutic Riding Center

profile.name: Rising Stars Therapeutic Riding Center
profile.description:
Our MISSION--Rising Stars is dedicated to providing safe and caring equine assisted activities to children and adults with special needs, empowering them to reach “Beyond the Reins of Limitation.” We are a 501 (c) (3) All donations are tax deductible. Federal ID number is 27-1255281
At Rising Stars Therapeutic Riding Center, every ride offers a chance for children and adults with physical, emotional, and cognitive challenges to gain strength, confidence, and independence. Through adaptive riding and equine-assisted activities, riders discover abilities they didn’t know they had — stretching muscles, calming emotions, and building connections in ways traditional therapies often can’t. Your donation ensures these life-changing experiences remain accessible to all, providing scholarships, program support, and care for our remarkable therapy horses. Give today and be part of transforming lives, one ride at a time.
